```{r helpers}
#| echo: false

load_subcluster_plot_data <- function(name) {
  # Map the script's internal names to the actual .RData file names
  name_map <- c("myeloid" = "Myeloid", "myocyte" = "Myocytes", "t_cell" = "TCell")
  file_name <- name_map[[name]]
  
  e <- new.env()
  load(here::here("data", "intermediate", "03_public_skin_rna", paste0("Labeled_", file_name, ".RData")), envir = e)
  
  sub <- e$sub
  markers <- e$markers
  markers_used <- e$markers_used
  labels <- e$labels
  
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(sub) <- "integrated"
  
  # 1. Extract UMAP Data
  umap_data <- Seurat::Embeddings(sub, "umap") |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    setNames(c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Identity = sub$Identity)
    
  # 2. Extract DotPlot Data using .R script logic
  markers_small <- markers |>
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
    dplyr::top_n(n = 2, wt = avg_log2FC)
    
  feat <- Map(c, markers_used, split(markers_small$gene, markers_small$cluster))
  feat <- unique(unlist(lapply(feat, unique)))
  
  dp <- Seurat::DotPlot(sub, features = feat, group.by = 'seurat_clusters', cluster.idents = TRUE)
  
  # 3. Build label lookup table
  label_lookup <- data.frame(
    id = levels(dp$data$id),
    cluster_label = labels[as.numeric(levels(dp$data$id)) + 1]
  )
  
  identity_levels <- if (is.factor(sub$Identity)) levels(sub$Identity) else sort(unique(sub$Identity))
  
  list(
    umap_data = umap_data,
    dot_data = dp$data,
    id_levels = levels(dp$data$id),
    feature_levels = levels(dp$data$features.plot),
    identity_levels = identity_levels,
    label_lookup = label_lookup
  )
}

abbreviate_subcluster_labels <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    x,
    "M1 Activated Macrophages" = "M1 macrophages",
    "CLEC9A+ DCs - Replicating" = "CLEC9A+ DCs (rep.)",
    "Langerhans Cells" = "Langerhans",
    "Dividing Venular ECs" = "Div. venular ECs",
    "Outer Root Sheath" = "Outer root sh."
  )
}

plot_subcluster_dotplot <- function(plot_data) {
  dot_data <- plot_data$dot_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      id = factor(as.character(id), levels = plot_data$id_levels),
      features.plot = factor(as.character(features.plot), levels = plot_data$feature_levels)
    )

  cluster_labels <- abbreviate_subcluster_labels(plot_data$label_lookup$cluster_label)
  names(cluster_labels) <- as.character(plot_data$label_lookup$id)

  ggplot2::ggplot(dot_data, ggplot2::aes(id, features.plot)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg.exp.scaled),
      stroke = 0
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
      position = "top",
      labels = cluster_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
      limits = rev(plot_data$feature_levels),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_size(
      range = c(0, 5),
      name = "% expressed",
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = c(25, 50, 75)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#d9d2e9",
      high = "blue",
      name = "Avg. expression",
      limits = c(-1, 2),
      breaks = c(-1, 0, 1, 2),
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.text.x.top = ggplot2::element_text(
        colour = "grey45",
        angle = 55,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 0,
        size = 7,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x.bottom = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey45", size = 6, face = "bold"),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.just = "center",
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      size = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        title.position = "top",
        order = 2,
        override.aes = list(color = "black")
      ),
      color = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
        title.position = "top",
        order = 1,
        barwidth = grid::unit(22, "mm"),
        barheight = grid::unit(3, "mm")
      )
    )
}

plot_subcluster_umap <- function(plot_data, title) {
  umap_data <- plot_data$umap_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(Identity = factor(as.character(Identity), levels = plot_data$identity_levels))

  ggplot2::ggplot(umap_data, ggplot2::aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = Identity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_discrete(
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = abbreviate_subcluster_labels
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1)
    )) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = "UMAP_1", y = "UMAP_2") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"),
      legend.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
}
```

```{r data}
#| echo: false
dir.create(here::here("fig_s14_files"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

### Panel S14A: Myeloid Subclusters

```{r s14a_myeloid_subclusters}
#| fig-cap: "Figure S14A"

figure_s14a_dotplot <- here::here(
  "fig_s14_files",
  "figure_S14a_myeloid_subcluster_markers_dotplot.png"
)

figure_s14a_umap <- here::here(
  "fig_s14_files",
  "figure_S14a_myeloid_subclusters_umap.png"
)

figure_s14a_data <- load_subcluster_plot_data("myeloid")
figure_s14a_dotplot_plot <- plot_subcluster_dotplot(figure_s14a_data)
figure_s14a_umap_plot <- plot_subcluster_umap(figure_s14a_data, "Myeloid cells")

ggplot2::ggsave(
  figure_s14a_dotplot,
  figure_s14a_dotplot_plot,
  device = ragg::agg_png,
  width = 3.5,
  height = 3.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  figure_s14a_umap,
  figure_s14a_umap_plot,
  device = ragg::agg_png,
  width = 3.5,
  height = 3.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::include_graphics(c(figure_s14a_dotplot, figure_s14a_umap))
```
